title: Application of Essex County Gas Company, pursuant to G.L. c. 164., §§ 2-1 through 2-10 and 220 C.M.R. §§ 7.00 et seq., for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of the Company's proposed surcharge for the Residential Energy Conservation Service Program for fiscal year 1995 (July 1, 1994 - June 30, 1995). Essex County Gas Company is a member utility of Mass-Save, Inc., which provides services in its behalf.
